common: Production animation SPRITE SHEET. EXACT 4 columns x2 rows, 8 equally spaced frames reading left to right top to bottom. Each figure very SMALL: only CENTRAL 45 percent of its square cell, INCLUDING ALL hair and sword. Enormous transparent padding on EVERY side. No part crosses a cell or image edge. Same character, camera, body proportions, size, white/blue clothing and long black ponytail in ALL frames, no outfit morphing. Reference is clothing identity only: simplified white outer robe, pale blue crossed collar and central skirt, plain navy sash with tiny silver buckle, black guards/boots, white hair tie. Chibi 2.7 heads, clean thick dark navy outline, minimal broad shadow planes. NO embroidery, particles, motion trails, glows, ground, shadows, text, labels or separators. True transparent alpha, clean edges. Fixed camera elevated three-quarter facing right. This is a coherent chronological animation, NOT unrelated pose variants. Every frame is a different incremental phase. Feet align to a fixed horizontal ground baseline across all cells; grounded support sole must be clearly visible.

actions.run: 8-frame seamless RUN cycle. Frame1 right foot forward ground contact, left leg behind;2 right planted foot travels back while torso advances, left knee swings forward;3 right toe pushes off, left knee high;4 airborne extension, left foot forward/right behind;5 left foot ground contact, right behind;6 left planted travels back, right knee forward;7 left toe pushes off right knee high;8 airborne right forward left behind returns to1. Strong opposite arm swing, torso leaning20degrees, visible alternating leg silhouettes. Preserve character scale.
actions.attackA: 8-frame quick sword THRUST. Frame1 neutral stance sword lowered;2 left/rear supporting foot planted torso crouches right elbow retracts;3 deeper low anticipation sword behind waist;4 forward torso extension elbow half-extended;5 full low lunge horizontal sword thrust to right, left/rear supporting foot planted EXACT same position;6 elbow retracts halfway with torso recovering;7 torso rises sword returns down;8 identical stance as1. Left rear supporting boot's sole stays at same screen coordinate through ALL8 frames. Entire SHORT sword within cell.
actions.attackB: 8-frame powerful TWO-HANDED diagonal sword CUT. Frame1 neutral wide stance;2 both hands lift sword beside shoulder;3 sword overhead torso twists left weight on rear boot;4 sword swings half-way downward;5 impact deep squat diagonal cut across body toward lower right;6 sword follows through at opposite hip;7 torso uncoils and straightens;8 identical stance as1. Rear boot's grounded sole stays in same screen position in ALL8 frames; body bends around it. Whole short sword within cell.
actions.castA: 8-frame palm projectile casting sequence.1 neutral;2 left elbow folds palm near waist;3 torso rotates palm draws back;4 left palm moves halfway forward;5 palm fully extended right sword tucked near hip, sleeves open;6 palm retracts halfway;7 returns toward neutral;8 neutral like1. Rear planted boot sole locked same coordinate each frame. No magic particles or effects.
actions.castB: 8-frame two-finger overhead sword-command sequence.1 neutral;2 left sword-finger hand rises to chest;3 fingers raised near forehead, right sword upward;4 fingers push forward, torso leans;5 both arms open one finger command points forward sword held beside face;6 fingers return near forehead;7 hand lowers to chest;8 neutral like1. Supporting rear boot fixed coordinate each frame. No magic particles or effects.
actions.state: 8-frame combined state strip. Frames1-4 form subtle IDLE breath cycle: upright, slightly inhale, full inhale, exhale with tiny cloth motion. Frames5-8 show HIT reaction recovery:5 flinch backward with both boots grounded;6 deepest recoil torso twisted and arms raised;7 recovering torso half straight;8 returns neutral. Support rear boot's sole fixed at same screen coordinate in all frames, no jumping. No impact effects.

preparation: Adaptive transparent-gap slicing, isolated component cleanup, uniform per-clip scale, per-frame dark boot sole pivot. 32 frames per variant; no production replacement.
